data.title: Illinois American Water Announces 2026 "Water Keeps Life Flowing" Art Contest
data.description: Belleville, Illinois - On October 16, 2026, a grade school contest was held by Illinois American Water to highlight the importance of high-quality water systems in students' everyday activities. The contest aimed to raise awareness among students by inviting them to demonstrate their creativity through artwork submissions. The initiative, called "Water Keeps Life," encouraged students to showcase their understanding of the vital role water plays in their lives. This event was organized to emphasize the significance of clean water and its impact on daily routines.

data.title: ASSA ABLOY sells PKI business unit to Vista Equity Partners
data.description: In Stockholm on October 16, 2026, ASSA ABLOY announced the sale of HID's PKI business unit to Vista Equity Partners. The PKI business unit, specializing in digital trust, identity, authentication, encryption, and certificate management, was acquired by Vista Equity Partners through the agreement. This strategic move signifies a significant development in the digital security sector, with key focus on public key infrastructure.

data.title: Heytea Opens Its First U.S. Gelato Lab+ in New York
data.description: Heytea, known for revolutionizing tea culture, is now introducing eight unique gelato and sorbet flavors made in-store. The brand, which continues to redefine the tea experience, is expanding its offerings beyond traditional teas. This development comes as Heytea continues to push the boundaries of what tea can be. The flavors are all crafted in-house and are set to bring a fresh twist to the world of desserts. This innovation marks a significant step for the company as it diversifies its product range. The move signals Heytea's commitment to remaining at the forefront of creating inventive tea-based products. Customers can now enjoy a range of tea-infused gelato and sorbet options at Heytea's locations.

data.title: Bank of America Declares Preferred Stock Dividends Payable in November and December 2026
data.description: In a recent announcement, Bank of America Corporation, based in Charlotte, N.C., revealed that its Board of Directors has given authorization for regular cash dividends to be paid out on outstanding shares or depositary shares of specific series of preferred stock. The dividend per share for each series of preferred stock was also specified in the disclosure. This signifies a significant financial move by the corporation, demonstrating its commitment to providing returns to its shareholders. The specifics of the dividends indicate a continued focus on rewarding investors, promoting stability in the market, and enhancing overall investor confidence.

data.title: The NXG Cushing® Midstream Energy Fund Announces Fund Name Change
data.description: On October 16, 2026, in Dallas, the NXG Cushing® Midstream Energy Fund (NYSE: SRV) disclosed alterations in its name and non-fundamental investment policies authorized by the Board of Trustees. These modifications will come into effect on December 18.

data.title: Akara Partners and Deven Group Close Financing on 305-Bed Class A Student Housing Development at San Diego State University
data.description: A collaborative effort between development partners will bring forth the construction of a transit-oriented development at 5077 College Avenue, located near the SDSU campus core. This project is expected to be completed by the 2028-2029 academic year. Akara Partners, a real estate investment, development, and operating firm, is involved in this initiative. This development aims to cater to the needs of the university community and enhance the area's infrastructure.

data.title: Ethereum sets Glamsterdam upgrade for Hoodi testnet on Oct. 26, raising gas limit by 200M; mainnet date pending.
data.description: The Glamsterdam upgrade for Ethereum is set to take place on October 26th in Hoodi. This upgrade will include a significant increase of 200 million to the gas limit. There is currently no specific date set for the release on the mainnet.

data.title: Qualia Legacy Advisors Advises The Blogger Agent on Sale to The Only Agency
data.description: In a recent development, Qualia Legacy Advisors has officially revealed its exclusive role as the sell-side advisor to The Blogger Agent following its acquisition by The Only Agency ("TOA"), a company under Presidio Investors. The terms of the deal were not disclosed. The acquisition strategically combines TOA's elite fashion, hair, and makeup talent with The Blogger Agent's network of beauty influencers. This move signifies the alignment of key players in the industry and highlights the potential for growth and collaboration in the ever-evolving landscape of influencer marketing.

data.title: AI reshapes hiring with junior tech hiring slowdown and agent hours surpassing employee hours 6 to 1, as work focuses on AI.
data.description: Anthropic has reported a decline in junior technical hiring, with an increase in agent hours surpassing employee hours at a ratio of 6 to 1. There has been a shift in focus towards managing artificial intelligence.

data.title: Tesla's new Roadster Rocket is an exclusive flying car, not for public roads, arriving in 2028.
data.description: The latest Tesla Roadster model was seen performing a dramatic feat, soaring through the air and successfully jumping over a series of Teslas before landing on SpaceX thrusters. This extraordinary Rocket version, exclusive to invitees only, is not permitted for use on public roads. The anticipated release date for this innovative vehicle is set for 2028.

data.title: ASA Gold and Precious Metals Limited Announces Distribution Declaration
data.description: ASA Gold and Precious Metals Limited (NYSE: ASA) in Portland, Maine, announced a distribution of $0.05 per common share, payable on November 12, 2026 to shareholders of record as of November 5, 2026. The company cautions against tying investment performance to the distribution amount, as future distributions may vary.

data.title: Kopin to Host Live YouTube "Ask Me Anything" Panel from Nasdaq MarketSite on the Future of AI Infrastructure
data.description: A company based in Westborough, Massachusetts, will host a live YouTube event titled "Ask Me Anything" at Nasdaq MarketSite. The discussion will focus on the future of AI infrastructure. This event aims to bring together experts and enthusiasts to delve into critical topics related to AI's development and growth. The event will be broadcast on YouTube to reach a wider audience and encourage engagement. This initiative reflects the growing interest and importance of AI technology in various sectors. The event is scheduled to take place at Nasdaq MarketSite, providing a prestigious backdrop for the discussion.

data.title: 8x8, Inc. Schedules Second Quarter Fiscal 2027 Earnings Release and Conference Call
data.description: In Campbell, California, 8x8, Inc. has announced the scheduling of its second quarter fiscal year 2027 earnings release and conference call. The company, listed on NASDAQ under the ticker symbol EGHT, will be sharing its financial results and insights with stakeholders during this event. Keep an eye out for updates regarding the performance and developments of 8x8, Inc. as they disclose important information during this scheduled event.

data.title: Power Integrations Reports Inducement Grants under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4)
data.description: In San Jose, California, Power Integrations (Nasdaq: POWI) disclosed that on October 15, 2026, they awarded a combined 25,325 RSUs and 1,339 PSUs to 12 employees who joined the company in September 2026. These grants were provided under Power Integrations’ Amended and Restated 2025 Inducement Award Plan. The RSUs will vest quarterly over the course of the coming four years.
